lines.text: Many learners say: Can I demand you something?
Better: Can I ask you something?
Demand is strong. Ask is normal.
Ask! Please ask him for help.

data.why: Demand is strong. Ask is normal.

native.tip: « Demander » se dit “ask”. “Demand” veut dire exiger : c’est très fort.
native.caption: Vous dites “Can I demand you something?” ? Faux ami ! Dites plutôt “Can I ask you something?” — écoutez Carlos et répétez avec lui ! Plus d’exercices dans l’appli Lexkite.
native.comment: Réponse : “ask” — “Demand” veut dire exiger : c’est trop fort. Testez d’autres pièges avec un quiz gratuit : {link}

en.tip: “Demand” means to require, which sounds very strong. To ask, say “ask”.
en.caption: Do you say this? “Can I demand you something?” False friend! Say “Can I ask you something?” Listen to Carlos and repeat with him! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
